info.title: Settly Core API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP API contract for the Settly real estate platform. Implements RFC 9457 error taxonomy, strict validation, and bilingual domain entities.

SessionCookie.name: settly_session
SessionCookie.description: Better Auth HTTP-only secure session cookie

type.description: Relative URI identifier of the specific problem type (machine-readable code)

title.description: Short human-readable developer summary of the problem type

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem
detail.example: One or more request parameters failed validation schema checks.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem

requestId.description: Authoritative request correlation ID (UUIDv7) for telemetry tracing

params.description: Structured machine-readable parameters for localized client error rendering

errors.description: Array of validation issues per field

licenseNumber.description: Official Egyptian Real Estate Regulatory Authority license number

bioEn.example: Specialist in New Cairo and Golden Square luxury villas.

bioAr.example: متخصص في فلل القاهرة الجديدة والمربع الذهبي.

verified.description: Verification decision: true to approve, false to revoke/reject

notes.example: License verified against Egyptian Real Estate Authority registry.

token.description: FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) device or browser push token

platform.description: Target platform for push notification dispatch

aliases.description: Alternative aliases or colloquial names for search autocomplete matching

parentId.description: Parent area UUIDv7 in the geographic hierarchy (e.g. Governorate for a City)

level.description: Geographic administrative level within the Egyptian real estate taxonomy

boundaryGeoJson.description: Optional GeoJSON boundary geometry string for map visualization

centerLat.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the area centroid

centerLng.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the area centroid

propertyTypesDistribution.description: Inventory count grouped by property type

historicalPriceTrend.description: Quarterly historical price per sqm telemetry

price.description: Price in EGP piastres as a numeric string

reason.example: Photos do not meet quality guidelines

id.description: Unique user identifier (canonical Better Auth user id)

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address has passed verification (Decision #38)

phone.description: Phone in E.164 format; null only for Google accounts that have not completed their profile (#60, #106). Never public

role.description: User role within Settly authorization matrix (AUTH.md §7)

preferredLocale.description: Preferred UI/notification locale (en or ar) per Decision #39

phone.description: Phone number, international format; normalised to E.164 (#60)

userId.description: Foreign key reference to Better Auth User

licenseNumber.description: Official Egyptian real estate brokerage license number

brokerageName.description: Optional brokerage or agency commercial name

bioEn.example: Specialist in luxury residential properties across New Cairo and Golden Square.

bioAr.example: خبير في العقارات الفاخرة بالقاهرة الجديدة والمربع الذهبي.

isVerified.description: Whether the agent's credentials have been verified by Settly compliance

licenseNumber.description: Official real estate brokerage license ID

brokerageName.description: Commercial brokerage or agency name if affiliated

items.description: Array of compared residences with aligned specifications

bioAr.example: مستشارة عقارية متخصصة في عقارات التجمع الخامس والقطامية.

get.description: Retrieve the hierarchical list of areas in Egypt (governorates, cities, districts, compounds). Supports filtering by administrative level and parent area.

schema.description: Geographic administrative level within the Egyptian real estate taxonomy

items.description: Array of geographic areas matching query criteria

get.description: Retrieve detailed area record by its UUIDv7 identifier.

get.summary: Get market insights and telemetry for an area
get.description: Retrieve price per m² averages, historical trend telemetry, compound counts, and property distributions for an area by slug or UUID.

schema.description: Area unique slug (e.g. new-cairo) or UUIDv7 identifier

200.description: Area market insights and historical trend telemetry

get.description: Returns paginated list of published and reserved properties for public browsing.

patch.summary: Update a property listing with two-tier moderation (P6)

get.summary: Get property details by SEO slug

post.summary: Submit draft listing for publication review (P2)
Offline-sale escape hatch for published property (P11)
Relist archived listing back to draft (P14)

get.description: Retrieve controlled vocabulary of property amenities, optionally filtered by category.

post.description: Issues signed Cloudinary upload parameters for direct client upload per STORAGE.md Section 3.
Binds uploaded provider asset to property record per STORAGE.md Section 3.

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile, role, verification status, and settings.

401.description: Unauthenticated request (missing or invalid session cookie)

patch.description: Update display name or language preference (en / ar) for the current user.

post.description: Register or update real estate license and brokerage profile details. Requires AGENT or ADMIN role.
